summary: The note states that Technicolor, formerly known as Thomson Consumer Electronics, claims to control MP3 licensing of the Layer 3 patents in many countries. These countries include the United States, Japan, Canada and EU member states. The note adds that Technicolor has been actively enforcing these patents.
one_line: Technicolor, formerly Thomson Consumer Electronics, claims control of MP3 Layer 3 patent licensing in many countries and actively enforces them.
key_facts: Technicolor was formerly called Thomson Consumer Electronics.
Technicolor claims to control MP3 licensing of the Layer 3 patents.
Technicolor's claimed MP3 Layer 3 patent licensing covers many countries.
Countries named in the note include the United States, Japan, Canada and EU countries.
Technicolor has been actively enforcing the MP3 Layer 3 patents.
